title: Style
description: rival: a small ladder beside the playfield — the player above you, your position, the player below, and the score gaps; it complements osu!'s own scoreboard. board: a full leaderboard drawn where osu!stable puts its scoreboard, for when you hide osu!'s.

title: Side
description: auto: rival on the right of the playfield (under the lane in taiko, beside the stage in mania), board on the left where osu!'s scoreboard sits.

title: Horizontal nudge / px
description: Moves the overlay right (positive) or left (negative) from its place, for skins that move osu!'s HUD.

title: Vertical nudge / px
description: Moves the overlay down (positive) or up (negative).

title: Backing
description: none: text straight on the game with a light shadow. scrim: a soft dark haze behind it. panel: a graphite 18-LAB panel.

title: Accent
description: map: highlight colour taken from the map's background. 18-lab: amber.

title: Board rows
description: Board style: most rows shown (1–16, fewer when the screen runs out). When you are below them, the top rows give way to the player you are chasing and your own row.

title: Board: compact
description: One line per row: position, name, accuracy, score.

title: Board: show gap to next position
description: Score you need to pass the player above you, or your lead when you are first.
